definitions.gloss: to cook; to prepare food; to make a dish
definitions.explanation: To process ingredients into a meal or dish through cutting, heating, seasoning, and other techniques. More formal or technical than {料理|りょうり}する.

examples.japanese: {魚|さかな}を{調理|ちょうり}する。
{食材|しょくざい}を{衛生的|えいせいてき}に{調理|ちょうり}することが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to prepare food hygienically.

examples.japanese: この{肉|にく}は{低温|ていおん}でじっくり{調理|ちょうり}すると{柔|やわ}らかくなる。
examples.english: This meat becomes tender when cooked slowly at low temperature.

notes:
More formal and technical than {料理|りょうり}する. While {料理|りょうり}する is the everyday word for cooking, {調理|ちょうり}する emphasizes the technical process of food preparation and is preferred in professional, institutional, and regulatory contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食材|しょくざい}を{調理|ちょうり}する: to prepare ingredients
- {調理|ちょうり}{器具|きぐ}: cooking utensils
- {調理|ちょうり}{師|し}: licensed cook
- {調理|ちょうり}{場|ば}: kitchen (professional)
- {調理|ちょうり}{法|ほう}: cooking method
- {調理|ちょうり}{実習|じっしゅう}: cooking practice (in school)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {料理|りょうり}する: to cook — everyday word; also used as a noun meaning "cuisine" or "dish"
- {煮炊|にた}きする: to cook (general boiling/simmering) — traditional; emphasizes basic home cooking
- {炊事|すいじ}する: to do the cooking — focuses on cooking as a household chore
